name: Zao Xu
bio: Born in 1991 in Anshan (China), Zao Xu is a screenwriter, director, and production designer. He studied at the Beijing Film Academy. His animated short No Changes Have Taken in Our Life premiered at the International Film Festival Rotterdam and received multiple national and international awards. His second short film, Love Music Friend, screened at the Shanghai International Film Festival. Light Pillar marks his debut feature film.

credits.title: Light Pillar
credits.overview: The future. Winter. Space travel is no longer a dream. A lonely janitor tends the grounds of a dilapidated bankrupt film studio with only a former cat actor for company until he embarks on a romantic journey with a female player in a beautiful virtual world.

credits.title: No Changes Have Taken In Our Life
credits.overview: Ba graduates from college with a major in sousaphone. With his suitcase packed and his instrument straddled to his body, he returns to his hometown, optimistic about finding a satisfactory job as a musical artist.
